title: Relieving letter
description: Letter confirming that an employee has been relieved of their duties, in the certificate layout.

params.title: RELIEVING LETTER
paragraphs: This is to certify that **{fullName}** was employed with **{company}** as **{designation}** from **{startDate}** to **{relievingDate}**.
{firstName} has been relieved of all duties with effect from the close of working hours on **{relievingDate}**.
The work assigned to {firstName} has been handed over and the exit formalities have been completed.
We wish {firstName} every success in the future.

fields.name: honorific
fields.label: Honorific
fields.help: Mr., Ms., Dr. … (printed before the name)

fields.name: salutationName
fields.label: Short name
fields.help: Used in the body; default: the first name

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Reason sentence
fields.help: Optional sentence, e.g. "This follows the resignation submitted by …"
